title: Surrender large-scale generation certificates or pay the shortfall charge
what: A liable entity (mainly electricity retailers) that has a large-scale generation shortfall for a year pays the shortfall charge.

sources.title: Renewable Energy (Electricity) Act 2000
sources.quote: 36 Large-scale generation shortfall charge payable by liable entity (1) Subject to subsection (2), if a liable entity has a large-scale generation shortfall for a year, large-scale generation shortfall charge is payable in respect of the shortfall.
